_comment: Zone definitions for marker-based occupancy. Copy to config/zones.json and edit.
Each zone lists the ArUco marker IDs physically placed at the corners of its floor area.
Marker order does not matter -- corners are sorted around their centroid, which assumes a convex zone.
A zone needs at least 3 markers, and only becomes active once every one of them has been mapped
by some camera, which is what lets two cameras each cover part of a zone neither of them sees whole.
One ID means one physical marker: never print two copies of the same ID and place them apart, since
the shared map treats an ID as a single location and would fuse the two into one wrong position.
Two zones that physically meet at a corner may both list that one marker's ID -- that is one marker
serving two zones, which is fine. Markers used only to bridge two cameras' views need no zone entry.
